title: Mathing with Dan and Bianca
text:
A podcast hosted by Daniel Ermanand Bianca Viray, where we give a glimpse of what mathematics looks like to working mathematicians.
What do mathematicians actually do all day? Join us as we talk about the practice of mathematics — the questions, the false starts, the collaborations, and the moments when things finally click.
